clusters.headline: 'This is our company': Nigerians show off oil wealth after share-buying frenzy
clusters.summary: Many Nigerians buy their first ever shares - in the oil refinery owned by Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote.

clusters.headline: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
clusters.summary: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

clusters.headline: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
clusters.summary: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.

clusters.headline: Africa: Unstoppable Africa 2026 to Bring African and Global CEOs and Leaders to Drive Investment and Growth Across The Continent
clusters.summary: [Global Compact] More than 2,000 African and global business leaders plus heads of state will gather in New York on September 20-21 for Unstoppable Africa, flagship event of the Global Africa Business Initiative (GABI).

clusters.headline: Najib’s house arrest puts Malaysia in ‘uncharted’ legal territory, poses political challenge for PM Anwar
clusters.summary: Former PM Najib Razak is likely the first convicted prisoner in Malaysia to have his sentence commuted to house arrest, experts say, adding that the move could pose a challenge for incumbent Anwar Ibrahim, given his anti-corruption pledge.

clusters.headline: South Africa: South Africa Stands Behind Grieving Families, Conveys Condolences - President Ramaphosa
clusters.summary: [SAnews.gov.za] President Cyril Ramaphosa has assured families who are grieving their loved ones that the nation stands with them.

clusters.headline: Uganda: Kisoro Residents Warned to Brace for Heavy Rains, Floods and Landslides Until 2027
clusters.summary: [Nile Post] Residents of Kisoro District in southwestern Uganda have been warned to prepare for heavier rainfall, floods, landslides and lightning strikes expected to persist through 2027.

clusters.headline: Coroner rules death of 17-year-old boy who was pinned by basketball frame a misadventure
clusters.summary: Dunking and holding on to the rim are “part and parcel of the game” and the basketball structure should easily have been able to withstand the forces involved, said the State Coroner.

clusters.headline: CASE sees rise in complaints over pre-owned cars; mileage tampering among issues flagged
clusters.summary: Industry players say squeezed margins and the difficulty of selling high-mileage cars can tempt unscrupulous dealers to manipulate odometers.
